caseNameFull: Wright v. City of Montgomery, Alabama

opinions.text:
C. A. 6th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for reconsideration in light of Younger v. Harris, ante, p. 37; Samuels v. Mackell, and Fernandez v. Mackell, ante, p. 66.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted and judgment reversed.
